reviews.text: This is a great game - one of the best auto shooters on Steam. I love Brotato, Deeprock Survivor, 20 minutes til dawn and other games like that. Earl is really challenging, has short runs and lets you make super powerful builds as you survive. This game is more arcadey than others that I've played too, which is fun. For one, driving around the car is really unique feeling in this genre. It's fun to try and drive over the creeps. Second, there's powerups and other spawns that pop up randomly and encourage you to explore the map. Anwyays, highly recommended!

I've played a few games in this genre and I will say this is probably the most satisfying one I've played! There's no greater feeling than lining up a bunch of dudes and then turning around and running them all over!

[b][i]Twin-stick shooter & top-down survival action-roguelite. It's a mix of Carmageddon and Vampire Survivors. You can shoot mutants and crush them with a car.[/i][/b] Edna gives you a car with weapons. Your goal is to complete certain tasks, destroy mutants and bosses. You can buy permanent upgrades for your car before the race. When you destroy enemies during a run, you can pick up boxes with weapons and drones, and also you increase your level and get the opportunity to choose one of three random upgrades, just like in the game Vampire Survivors. The game has three locations and three bosses, for killing which you get new vehicles. + Beautiful graphics. + Dynamic, fun gameplay. + 3 locations. + 3 bosses. + 4 vehicles. + Various weapons, upgrades and drones. + You can crush/hit/strike mutants with a car. + Achievements.
Cool and action racing with a lot of effects and nice control under which you can relax and beautifully crush mutants on a cool car with different weapons

Having sucked all the blood out of Vampire Survivors and patiently waiting for the next Hades II patch, I've found Earl vs. the Mutants to be the perfect thing to satisfy my endless craving for roguelike action! This is a really impressive first title for a new indie studio. The controls are quite intuitive, and the gameplay is so addictive. It strikes a very good balance of making you feel like a bad*ss while challenging you with ever-increasing crazy chaos. I look forward to possible future updates and expansions!
The driving and shooting is fun but there is absolutely not enough content. Also the dialogue is atrocious.

When I suffered from recurring sinusitis, draining all my energy and barely able to sit down in front of my computer, I didn't expect anything. But the experience of getting in Earl's car and firing a shotgun helped me forget the pain I was feeling on the left side of my face. I've got just 10 more drifts to go before I take antibiotics. I think the medicine will be more effective then...

[h1]任你万千尸群聚拢，我自驱车狂飙！[/h1] 《Earl vs. the Mutants》是由Falling State Inc.自研自发的一款以屠杀丧尸为主题的俯视角射击幸存者游戏，游戏里我们需要驾驶武装过的车辆，面对如潮一般的丧尸群，射击或撞击来保护自己不被干掉，并在时间内存活下来！ 说实话感觉《Earl vs. the Mutants》的美术多少有点AI痕迹，不过并不影响我们很愉悦的体验游戏，游戏的场景里有着高低差地形的存在，错落有致，对我们驾驶车辆狂奔有一定的影响，并且时不时还会阻碍子弹的弹道，也算是游戏的特色之一吧！ 游戏除了和其他幸存者类游戏一样利用武器来击杀丧尸外，还能一脚油门撞死丧尸，特别是它们聚拢成群的时候更是有奇效，不过加速和漂移的时机很重要，不然分分钟就成了送羊入虎口了！除了车顶上加装的武器之外，无人机也是我们克敌制胜保护自己的一种手段，游戏提供了多种多样功能不一的无人机任我们挑选，这个根据升级时获得的提升效果来组合成BD流派，同样也和属性的选择一样，最好选择适合自己的，而不是一味选择等级高的！ 整体而言，游戏还是相当不错的，虽说难度有点点高，但是玩起来另有一番滋味，开车狂飙，枪扫尸群，是不是有一种单枪匹马杀入千军万马的感觉？爽就完事了！ [quote]欢迎关注我们的鉴赏家:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35402982/]走心评测[/url] ←遵从内心，写出真实感受 欢迎加入我们Steam组:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/ZXPC]走心评测[/url]←点击加入，一起探索游戏的乐趣 喜欢这篇评论，也麻烦点个赞，让更多人能够看到！[/quote]

The idea of being in a car instead of a dude on foot is an interesting take on the genre. It seems like it should be a fun twist. But there's this weird tension in the game where you're incentivize to run over enemies, but only some enemies because there’s some types that explode when you hit them (and they’re often mixed into crowds of other enemies). And there's some enemies where sometimes you can run them over without getting hurt, but sometimes you can't and it's impossible to time the difference because they come in swarms where they're all in various states of hurt/safe. I played a bunch of rounds and beat the first map on the middle difficulty. Unfortunately, that win felt like it was just an RNG blessing rather than being good at the game (I had a shotgun with explosive+piercing+splitting bullets with projectile count, RoF, and damage bonuses, an infinite boost upgrade, and picked up a shooting frenzy powerup during the boss battle that melted the boss in about 10s). It’s possible the game gets better the more you play and the better able you are to distinguish enemy types and attack patterns...but I don’t care enough to find out.

Good little game. There are some minor balance issues when you first start playing with the default car, but you can quickly bypass them after a few rounds of upgrades and then the game becomes a neat little timesink. There is a lot of creativity on offer. And it's priced extremely fairly. I don't know if there's compelling replayability, but certainly a nice game to have in your collection for when you have 10 minutes to spare. Probably the best game design decision in here is that the rounds are 10 minutes to the boss, so it's not endless unless you want another round. I think some people might miss an endless mode, but I don't think it suits any of the other design decisions they've made.
